notes: I changed the nonzero region from the three points {-1,0,1} to the continuous interval [-1.5, 1.5], since E2 shows 1.0 at every value from -1.5 to 1.5 (including non-integers) and 0.0 at ±3, while E1 shows 0.0 at ±2 — so the true boundaries lie somewhere in (-2,-1.5] and [1.5,2), and I'm guessing they're exactly at ±1.5.
